status: PROPOSED / ONGOING. Frozen before the first run of scripts/oa_experiment.py. Do not edit after results exist; add a new file instead.
disclosure: Before freezing, one smoke run was seen at n=1024, delta=1/16, seed 0 (uniform amortized 3.76; elastic amortized 146.2, case3 0; funnel amortized 34.9, max 176, bound 228). P4 and P7 were written after seeing it.
metric: search probe complexity as the paper defines it (index in the 1-D probe sequence; phi(i,j) for elastic). 'late' = mean over the last ceil(1%) of insertions.

predictions.P1: uniform amortized within +-10% of ln(1/delta)/(1-delta) at every delta (random probing, Sec. 1: Theta(log 1/delta))
predictions.P2: uniform late-window mean >= 0.5/delta at every delta (worst-case expected O(1/delta), Sec. 1)
predictions.P3: elastic amortized(1/64) / amortized(1/8) <= 1.35 (Theorem 1: O(1) amortized, flat in delta)
predictions.P4: elastic amortized > uniform amortized at every tested delta (phi constants: phi(1,1)=13; Theorem 1 is asymptotic)
predictions.P5: elastic late-ratio (1/64 vs 1/8) < uniform late-ratio (Theorem 1 O(log 1/delta) vs O(1/delta))
predictions.P6: funnel max probe complexity <= alpha*beta + B cap + 2*C bucket in every run (structural, Sec. 3)
predictions.P7: funnel late mean >= uniform late mean at every tested delta (Theorem 2 win over Yao is asymptotic; 8 log^2 vs 1/delta crosses only near delta ~ 2^-10)
predictions.P9: no TableFailure in 36 runs and elastic case-3 insertions total <= 2 (Lemma 2: whp none)
predictions.P10: zero reordering violations in every run (no_reorder_audit)

not_claimed: The paper proves nothing about AI agents. None of these predictions is about agents. Mapping to receipts is analogy.
